title: The ULTIMATE Raid-Proof Mountain Base! 🏔️ | RuneScape: Dragonwilds
author: VikingRevival
description:
Want a base that raids simply CAN’T reach? 🏔️⚔️

In this RuneScape: Dragonwilds build, we head to the top of a massive mountain and construct a towering base high above the world! Not only does this location give us an incredible view across almost the entire map, but it also has one HUGE advantage — raids can’t even access us!

We’ll build the tower from the ground up, take advantage of this incredible location, and create one of the safest bases we’ve built so far.

If you’re looking for a great base location, want protection from raids, or just want an amazing view, this build might be exactly what you’re looking for!

👍 If you enjoy the build, hit Like!
🔔 Subscribe for more RuneScape: Dragonwilds builds, guides, tips, and adventures.

#RuneScapeDragonwilds #Dragonwilds #RuneScape #BaseBuilding #Gaming #VikingRevival
